_note: XAUUSD_INTRADAY_BB_CONFLUENCE — Historical Lab v1. Single hypothesis (ZONE_REJECTION_v1). No parameter sweep. BB = BigBeluga zones (canonical slim representation via Custom OB). Purpose: answer 'does the BigBeluga zone-rejection thesis have a raw historical edge?' before any forward test or operational promotion.

zone_definition.rationale: Custom OB is the slim's canonical implementation of BigBeluga-style supply/demand zones. No explicit 'bigbeluga_zone_*' fields exist; SMC OB (smc_nearest_bullish_ob_* / smc_nearest_bearish_ob_*) is the fallback alternative, not used in v1.
zone_definition.zone_lookup: parent 1H bar OR parent 4H bar (whichever zone edge is closer to current 15M close, via abs(distance)); never both

long_trigger.summary: Bar 15M entrou em DEMAND zone (1H ou 4H) e fechou bullish.
rules_all_required: zone selected from parent 1H or 4H (zone_type == DEMAND)

short_trigger.summary: Bar 15M entrou em SUPPLY zone (1H ou 4H) e fechou bearish.
rules_all_required: zone selected from parent 1H or 4H (zone_type == SUPPLY)

sanity: atr14_wilder not null at signal bar
risk <= 8 * atr14_wilder (otherwise zone too wide; skip)

entry.fill: close_of_signal_bar (proxied as bar i+1 open in reporting, but entry_price = close[i])

trade_generation.episode_definition: Signal episode = single 15M bar. No-overlap enforced by skipping signals whose bar <= last_exit_bar.

regimes.note: Window is 2024-05 → 2026-05 — entirely inside the bull_recent regime. No regime variation possible in this lab.

diagnostic_fields._note: All diagnostic only. NOT used as filters in v1.
